name: A Stainless Story
printed_text: If your opponent controls more cards than you: Send 1 "Stain" monster from your Deck or face-up in your opponent's Deck to the GY; this effect becomes the sent monster's effect if it is Normal or Special Summoned. You can banish this card from your GY; each player draws 1 card. You can only activate 1 "A Stainless Story" per turn.
